name: rocotal-prompt-scan
description: Scans every Codex prompt with Rocotal before the model reads it.

interface.shortDescription: Scan prompts with Rocotal before the model reads them
interface.longDescription: Monitor-only: every prompt Codex submits is scanned by Rocotal before the model reads it, so Guardrails evidence labels its sensitivity. Nothing is blocked, and a prompt still reaches the model when Rocotal is unreachable.
